data.gender_notes: Anah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anā' meaning 'to console' or 'to support'. Anah is a name that evokes feelings of grace, comfort, and consolation. It is a name that signifies the unwavering support and comfort of Allah. The name Anah carries the meaning “Grace, Comfort, Consolation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, comfort, consolation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
